title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria - The student provides the correct estimated number of Ar-37 atoms produced per day.

title: Assumptions Listed
description: Important Criteria - The student clearly states the assumptions made during the calculation.

title: Correct Density Use
description: Important Criteria - The student correctly uses the density of CCl4 to calculate the number of Cl nuclei.

title: Cross Section Application
description: Important Criteria - The student correctly applies the interaction cross section of neutrinos with Cl nuclei in the calculation.

title: Energy Threshold Mentioned
description: Optional Criteria - The student mentions the energy threshold for neutrino detection and its significance.

title: Improvement Suggestions
description: Optional Criteria - The student suggests feasible improvements to the experiment for better detection.

title: Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student makes errors in calculations, leading to an incorrect final answer.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student fails to maintain consistent units throughout the calculations.
